_comment: The Biscuit attenuation vocabulary (biscuit.go). This module and every SDK that attenuates its tokens test their names against this file, so a fact renamed on one side fails the other's tests. An attenuation block holds only the facts below, one term each; any other fact, and any rule or check, makes the verifier refuse the whole token. Amounts are nanos, billionths of the capability's unit.

authority._comment: The authority block holds one fact: the capability JWT, whose claim root_claim is the base64url Ed25519 public key that roots the Biscuit's signature chain.
